description: This file contains functions and scripts for managing system upgrades on MediaTek MT7623-based devices, including full system upgrades, image verification, and configuration copying.

methods.name: legacy_mtk_mmc_full_upgrade
methods.description: Performs a full system upgrade for MediaTek SoCs including handling partition differences and device firmware updates.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Determines the platform board type and performs the appropriate upgrade procedure.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Verifies whether the provided image is compatible with the current device based on magic values.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies configuration files to the device's recovery partition based on the board type.
